title: 玻璃の揺籠と、死せる秒針の円舞曲
author: 硝子 シオン

en.title: The Glass Cradle and the Waltz of the Lifeless Second Hand
en.premise: In a city where the forbidden art of crystallizing memories into gemstones still lingers, I encounter twins clutching a broken pocket watch. One has lost their soul; the other, as a price, has faded into a transparent shell. To set their frozen time in motion once more, they entrust me with the most cruel and beautiful of tasks: the 'Stripping of Memories.' It is a dance toward ruin, destined to imprison the form of a loved one in glass for all eternity.

zh.title: 玻璃摇篮与死寂秒针的圆舞曲
zh.premise: 在一座仍残留着将记忆结晶化为宝石之禁术的城市中，我遇见了一对持有破碎怀表的双胞胎。一人失去了灵魂，另一人则作为代价，身体逐渐变得透明。为了让停滞的时间重新流动，他们向我请求最残酷而美丽的『记忆剥离』。而这，是一场将挚爱之人的身影永远封印在玻璃之中，通往毁灭的圆舞曲。
